profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I leverage over eight years of experience in Java, Spring, and AngularJS to create innovative solutions for the financial industry. I have contributed to multiple projects that enhance user experience and efficiency. I am passionate about learning new technologies and staying updated with industry trends.

I also hold a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology from the University of Central Florida, where I developed a strong foundation in programming languages and software engineering principles. 

In addition to my technical skills, I have a unique background in acting, which has helped me develop strong communication and presentation skills. I am always eager to collaborate with diverse teams and tackle challenging problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented robust test frameworks for Labor and Health Systems at The Walt Disney Company.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality software delivery across various projects.  
• Focused on enhancing system architecture to improve testing efficiency and reliability.

positions.title: Systems & Process Integration Manager
positions.description:
Technologies
Java 17, NextJS, React, JavaScript, Mustache, HTML, CSS, Hibernate, MSSQL, Git, Confluence, JUnit, Jira

Responsibilities and Achievements
• Create and manage CI/CD pipeline for internal Global Trade Management Web Application using Jenkins and 
GitHub webhooks.
• Leveraged AGGrid and ChartJS libraries to create dashboards for Finance to evaluate savings program trends and generate reports.
• Built and maintained Confluence site for internal documentation of internal/external user guides reducing  onboarding time from 2+ weeks to < 2 days.
• Architected and maintained internal finance and payment auditing systems used to process, validate, and monitor invoice payments and SAP posting workflows using Java 17.
• Designed secure, auditable transaction flows supporting finance operations with compliance and data‑integrity considerations.
• Improved system reliability and maintainability by eliminating 250+ OWASP security issues and refactoring  legacy components across multiple applications.
• Improved coding standards and application reliability by performing regular code reviews and mentoring team 
members to establish best practices.
• Experimented with Copilot and Cursor in addition to Disney's various AI options seeking to improve coding speed and test coverage; shared findings with team to drive consistent usage and shared understanding.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies
Java 8/17/21, Spring Boot, Angular 15, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS, Hibernate, MSSQL, DB2, RPG, CL, Selenium, JUnit, JIRA, SNOW, CMS, BitBucket, Git

Responsibilities and Achievements
● Acted as a senior technical resource through code reviews, mentoring, and architecture discussions across frontend and backend team.
● Implemented unit test coverage thresholds.
● Built and maintained high‑volume banking and payment applications supporting teller operations, check processing, and fraud detection across client financial institutions.
● Developed RESTful APIs and fraud‑screening integrations that reduced fraudulent check acceptance by 30%.
● Participated in production support and incident resolution for customer‑facing banking systems, including root‑cause analysis and remediation.
● Contributed to performance tuning and system reliability improvements in high‑throughput financial services applications.
● Led initiative that refined client-facing technical documentation into a searchable database to reduce client reported issues by 35%.
